PM Modi to inaugurate Chennai Metro Phase 2 stretch

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch of Chennai Metro Phase 2 on Sunday, October 11. The inauguration will include details on the station list and train timings for passengers.
